The `lucent` module exposes three namespaces as part of the scripting API.

## Namespaces

| Namespace | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `api` | Perform in-game actions and check the current state. |
| [`script`](/reference/scripting/script/) | Work with the current script and its runtime. |
| `features` | Control higher-level automations. |

## Other modules

The [`effect` module](/reference/scripting/effect/) exposes the Effect utilities available to scripts; you probably don't need this.
